verdicts.rationale: Both are Plato: Complete Works, ed. Cooper, 1997, Hackett; ISBN 0-87220-349-2 == 9780872203495.
Same review of Lewis's Counterfactuals: identical authors, journal (Philosophy of Science), vol 42, no 3, pp 341-344, DOI 10.1086/288656. The b 'title' is just the reviewed-book header string.

Different papers: 'advantage for faces' (2007, Psychonomic Bulletin & Review, DOI 10.3758/bf03196811) vs 'advantage for objects of expertise' (2009, JEP:HPP, extra author Glazek, DOI 10.1037/0096-1523.35.1.94).
Same book Image and Mind by Gregory Currie, 1995, CUP; b title has trailing OCR noise ('. Film').
1st edition (1871, J. Murray, DOI 10.5962/bhl.title.2092) vs explicitly '2nd ed' (1874). Different editions of the Descent of Man.
1st edition (1871) vs explicitly '2nd ed' (1874). Different editions.
Both Kosslyn's Image and Brain (subtitle 'The Resolution of the Imagery Debate'), 1994, MIT Press; identical ISBN 9780262111843.
Same DeMatteo chapter 'Visual Imagery and Visual Analogues in American Sign Language', 1977, pp 109-137; b has typo 'Visusal'.

Same article 'Styles of Mental Representation', Proceedings of the Aristotelian Society vol 83, pp 213-226; year 1982 vs 1983 is a one-off metadata discrepancy, b confirmed by DOI 10.1093/aristotelian/83.1.213.
Same book Brainchildren: Essays on Designing Minds, Dennett, 1998, MIT Press; a has spurious OCR co-authors and a different ISBN printing.
Same Deregowski book (Illusions, Patterns and Pictures: A Cross-Cultural Perspective), 1980, Academic Press; b title truncated and subtitle leaked into publisher field.
Same anthology Mind Design (ed. Haugeland), 1981, MIT Press; ISBN 0-262-08110-5 == 9780262081108. a lacks the editor field.
Same article 'Stimulus-selective properties of inferior temporal neurons in the macaque', Desimone et al., 1984, J. Neurosci. vol 4, pp 2051-2062.
Same Desimone et al. 1984 J. Neurosci. article, vol 4, pp 2051-2062; b confirmed by DOI.
Same Desimone et al. 1984 article (identical author list, title, vol 4, pp 2051-2062, DOI 10.1523/jneurosci.04-08-02051.1984); differs only in citekey/type.

Different works: Shin's book 'The Logical Status of Diagrams' (CUP, 1994) vs her journal article 'Peirce and the logical status of diagrams' (History and Philosophy of Logic 15(1):45-68, DOI 10.1080/01445349408837224).
Book 'The Logical Status of Diagrams' (CUP, 1994) vs journal article 'Peirce and the logical status of diagrams' (H&PL 15(1):45-68). Distinct works.
Same article 'Topographic reorganization of the hand representation in cortical area 3b...', Recanzone et al., 1992, J. Neurophysiol. vol 67, pp 1031-1056.
Same O'Keefe & Dostrovsky 1971 article 'The hippocampus as a spatial map. Preliminary evidence...', Brain Research vol 34, pp 171-175; b has subtitle leaked into journal field.
Same Dowty article 'Thematic Proto-Roles and Argument Selection', Language vol 67 no 3 pp 547-619; year 1990 is an error (b DOI 10.2307/415037 confirms 1991).
